  1A)          Draw a single transition diagram to identify logical operators (&&,||,!), bitwise

  $$"S = (( p / w - x ) + y] ) *5.0".                                                        (3)$$

  state. And  
  construct the CLR (1) parse table for the same.                                          (5)  
  P→ mPnP | nPmP | ε

  S → Term Length  
  Term → integer  
  Term → float  
  Term → character                                                                         (3)  
  Length → Length, id  
  Length → id  
  Indicate all the handles and the corresponding reducing production rules in right-  
  sentential form for the input string: "integer id,id"  
  
  2C)          Write a BISON program to parse the following Boolean expression : (1) A And B and  
  (2) A Or B. Both "And" and "Or" logical operator has left associativity and same         (2)  
  precedence.
